description: Sets the program to calculate accumulated plastic strain tensor for constitutive models that include the property name plastic-strain . This command must be explicitly specified as either on or off to enable calculations. The default setting is off .

examples.description: Calculate the accumulated plastic strain tensor

notes: Accepted by the 9.8 PFC, FLAC, 3DEC, MPoint and MassFlow builds; 9.00 and 7.0 reject it.
